name: TobeXR
summary: TobeXR is the XR viewer for data published from Tobe Builder Lite, Pro and Ultimate. It allows you to view your BIMs, animated resources, 4D construction sequence and more in Virtual Reality and Mixed Reality (passthrough). Inspect properties, access your complete BIM object-tree/hierarchy, modify BIM element visibility, play your 4D construction sequence at 1:1 scale or on a table at 1:1000 scale.
